scenes.say: A language model only knows what it saw in training. It has never read your docs, your wiki, or anything from last week.
RAG fixes that in three steps.

items.title: Retrieve
items.text: find passages that match the question
items.say: Retrieve: search your documents for passages that match the question.

items.title: Augment
items.say: Augment: paste those passages into the prompt.

items.title: Generate
items.text: answer from what it was given
items.say: Generate: the model answers from what it was just handed.

scenes.code:
Answer using only these sources.

[1] "Refunds are issued within 14 days."
[2] "Email billing@acme.dev for help."

Question: "How long do refunds take?"
scenes.say: Nothing gets retrained. The model just reads the right page at the right moment, and can point to where its answer came from.

scenes.text:
Don't teach the model.
*Hand it the page.*
scenes.say: That's RAG. Don't teach the model everything. Hand it the right page.
